shared_elements: carved panel cut into a natural rock cliff face
flat rectangular field of decoration framed by unworked rock
rows/registers of small repeated carved signs or motifs
justification: Both surfaces are large rectangular fields worked directly into a cliff face, each combining human figures in relief with adjacent bands of small repeated carved signs, and both use shallow sunk relief on a flat prepared panel bordered by rough natural rock. The decisive difference in content is that A's field is dominated by a group of standing figures set in a deep niche, while B's is dominated by dense columns of small sign-like elements with only a single small figural vignette near the top, so the specific figure-to-figure relationships cannot be matched.
